intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Two visitors have stopped on the path to greet Nerelle in the water. One bows. The other waves.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Each notices the other and adds the missing gesture. Now both are bowing and waving at once.

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “Etiquette has reached an impasse. The gestures are becoming competitive.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “Three ceremonial committees have studied the question. Their report is in its fourth volume.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: The taller visitor adds a curtsy. A passing duck receives most of it.

options.labelText: “What do you like? A hello? A wave?”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Three committees, and nobody thought to ask me.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Hello is perfect. A wave is lovely. Bowing to ducks is discouraged.”

options.labelText: “Bow, obviously. You can’t go wrong bowing to royalty.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: The visitors overhear and bow low. Sea protocol says a bow must be returned, so Nerelle bows back. They bow again.

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “This is how the last treaty signing took nine days.”
